title: af.task-partial-candidate/1
description: The tree a source-writing Worker left when its Attempt wall ended it (ADR-0253), the payload of `af/TaskPartialCandidate@1`, sealed exactly as an ordinary candidate is (the same shell scratch and ignore exclusions): the Snapshot it started from, the derived Snapshot of what it left and the `af/SourceTree@1` naming it, and how many paths differ. Raw evidence of the failed Attempt, named by its `af/TaskAttemptWallEnd@1`; never an output, so it is never sealed into a result, checked, reviewed, accepted or delivered on its own. `af task run NEW --from TASK` binds it as the new Task's source.
